variant.title: Counting Circles Sudoku
variant.description: In each marked group, a digit d must appear exactly d times.
rule.counting_circles: If digit d appears in a circle group, it must appear exactly d times in that group.
rule_guide.title: Counting Circles Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: In a marked group, every digit d must occur exactly d times, including its own cell.
rule_guide.item_3: Marked groups are independent; unmarked cells have no Counting Circles restriction.
